rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: Kusukela enothini lakho lokuqala kuya ekudlaleni ngeminwe, i-blues ne-lead

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Sibambe, usishune, udlale amanothi akho okuqala.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Intambo ewugqinsi kunazo zonke inomsindo ophansi kunazo zonke. Iseduze nobuso bakho uma udlala. Siyibiza ngentambo 6.

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Intambo ngayinye inesikhonkwane sokushuna ekhanda. Ukusijikisa kushintsha ukuphakama komsindo. Timbre iyalalela ikutshele ukuthi ujikisele ngakuphi.

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Izintambo zibalwa kusukela kwezacile kunazo zonke (1) kuya kwewugqinsi kunazo zonke (6).

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Ncinza intambo ewugqinsi kunazo zonke uyiyeke ikhale.

rows.source: E A D G B E
rows.translation: E A D G B E

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: Kusukela kwewugqinsi kuya kwezacile: E, A, D, G, B, E. Khumbula ngezinhlamvu zokuqala: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Beka ichopho lomunwe eduze ngemuva kwe-fret yensimbi, hhayi phezu kwayo. Cindezela ngokwanele ukuze umsindo ucace.

rows.source: Open, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.
rows.translation: Evulekile, i-fret 1, i-fret 3: E, F, G.

rows.source: Between two frets, in the middle
E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: I-chord E minor isebenzisa iminwe emibili ku-fret 2, ezintanjeni 5 no-4. Zonke izintambo ziyakhala.

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Shaya zonke izintambo eziyisithupha, usuke kwewugqinsi uye kwezacile, ngokunyakaza okukodwa okushelelayo. Gcina isihlakala sikhululekile.

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Le nselelo ihlanganisa iyunithi yonke: izintambo ezivulekile, E, F no-G entanjeni 1, kanye ne-chord E minor. Donsa umoya phakathi kwezinyathelo.

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: Kusukela kwewugqinsi kuya kwezacile, izintambo ezivulekile zithi…

rows.source: E B G D A E
rows.translation: E B G D A E

rows.source: A D G B E A
rows.translation: A D G B E A

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Izinhlamvu zokuqala ze-Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually zithi: E A D G B E, intambo 6 kuya entanjeni 1.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb: amanothi amathathu

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: I-Mary Had a Little Lamb idinga amanothi amathathu: intambo 2 evulekile ingu-B, i-fret 2 entanjeni 3 ingu-A, kanti intambo 3 evulekile ingu-G. Umunwe wakho wesibili udlala u-A.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Intambo 3, i-fret 2, umunwe wesibili. Ngu-A lowo.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: intambo 2 evulekile, bese kuba yintambo 3.

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Amanothi ezintanjeni 1 no-2, ukufunda i-tab, nemiculo yakho emibili yokuqala.

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Intambo 2 isebenza njengentambo 1. Ivulekile, ingu-B. Ku-fret 1 ngomunwe wokuqala ingu-C. Ku-fret 3 ngomunwe wesithathu ingu-D.

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Intambo 2, i-fret 1, umunwe wokuqala. Ngu-C lowo.

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Intambo 2, i-fret 3, umunwe wesithathu. Ngu-D lowo.

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Umunwe owodwa ku-fret ngayinye: i-fret 1 ithola umunwe 1, i-fret 2 ithola umunwe 2, i-fret 3 ithola umunwe 3.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Beka isithupha sakho ngemuva kwentamo, siqondane nomunwe wesibili. Iminwe yakho ingakwazi ukugoba bese icindezela ngamachopho.

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: I-tab inemigqa eyisithupha, owodwa entanjeni ngayinye, intambo 1 iphezulu. Inombolo emgqeni iyi-fret okufanele uyicindezele. U-0 usho ukudlala leyo ntambo ivulekile.

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Umgqa ophezulu uyintambo 1, ezacile kunazo zonke. Inombolo iyi-fret.

rows.source: A 0 on the second line means…
A note that lasts two beats
A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Inothi elinguhhafu likhala izigqi ezimbili. Ncinza kanye, ubale kunye, kubili, uliyeke liqhubeke lize lifike elilandelayo.

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Uhhafu webha enezigqi ezine yizigqi ezimbili. Inothi eliyikota lithatha isigqi esisodwa.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Ukusuka entanjeni 2 uye ku-1 kudinga ukunyakaza okuncane. Gcina isandla esincinzayo siseduze nezintambo ukuze ulungele inothi elilandelayo.

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: I-fret 3 entanjeni 2, bese kuba yintambo 1 evulekile. Phakamisa umunwe uma uncinza.

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C no-D entanjeni 2, bese kuba ngu-E, F no-G entanjeni 1.

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Lo mculo uvela ku-Symphony Yesishiyagalolunye ka-Beethoven. Usebenzisa u-C, D, E, F no-G, futhi ngokuvamile uhamba ngesinyathelo esisodwa ngesikhathi.

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Umugqa wokuqala, kancane: E E F G G F E D.

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Bese: C C D E E D D.

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Umugqa ngamunye uphetha ngesigqi esinyakazayo: inothi elide, elisheshayo, bese kuba elibanjwayo. Bala u-one-and-two, ufake inothi elisheshayo ku-and.

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Lo mculo wezingane uhamba ngo-C, D no-E, bese ugxumela ku-G. Ugxuma usuka entanjeni 1 evulekile uye ku-fret 3.

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: intambo 1 evulekile, wehle uye entanjeni 2 ubuye.

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D entanjeni 2, bese kuba ngu-E no-G entanjeni 1.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox

Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Letters in a Shoebox, i-ballad enensayo ku-C. Ikhorasi yayo isezintanjeni 1 no-2, futhi ibinzana layo elihehayo liqala ngesigqi eside, esifushane osidlale ku-Ode to Joy. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Ibinzana elihehayo: C no-D entanjeni 2, bese kuba ngu-E, F no-G entanjeni 1, ubuyele ku-D.

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
No, it wants to go on
No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: E, F no-G entanjeni 1, B, C no-D entanjeni 2. Qala kancane, bese ugcina i-tempo engaguquki.

rows.source: Did the tune go up or down?
All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Wonke amanothi ayisithupha, kusuka kwaphansi kuya kwaphezulu.

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb, ngokushesha

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: E minor, E, A minor no-A, kudlalwa ngokucacile, nokushintsha kwakho ama-chord okokuqala.

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Cindezela ngamachopho eminwe, iminwe igobe njengebhuloho, ukuze kungabi namunwe othinta intambo engaphansi kwawo. Izinzipho ezimfushane zikwenza kube lula kakhulu.

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Ncinza izintambo ngayinye ngokulandelana, kusuka kwewugqinsi kuya kwezacile. Umsindo ongacacile usho ukuthi umunwe uthinta leyo ntambo. Lungisa bese uyincinza futhi.

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Intambo eyodwa ayikhali kahle. Yini engase ibe imbangela?

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Ichopho lomunwe elithinta intambo eseceleni liyayivimba ingakhali. Gobisa iminwe yakho kakhudlwana.

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Gcina ukuma kwe-E minor bese wengeza umunwe wokuqala entanjeni 3, ku-fret 1. Lelo nothi elilodwa lishintsha i-minor ibe yi-major.

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Ama-chord e-major avame ukuzwakala ekhanya futhi ezinzile. Ama-chord e-minor azwakala emnyama ngokwengeziwe. U-E no-E minor bahluka ngenothi elilodwa kuphela.

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: I-A minor iwukuma kwe-E okususelwe entanjeni elandelayo ezacile: iminwe 2 no-3 ku-fret 2, umunwe 1 entanjeni 2, ku-fret 1.

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo yilelo i-chord eqanjwe ngalo. Ku-A minor liyintambo 5 evulekile, ngakho qala ukushaya lapho, weqe intambo 6.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo le-A minor liyintambo 5 evulekile. Qala ukushaya izintambo lapho.

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: Ku-A, iminwe 1, 2 no-3 isondelene ku-fret 2, ezintanjeni 4, 3 no-2. Qala ukushaya entanjeni 5.

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Uma iminwe iminyene, yitshekise kancane ukuze ngamunye uhlale eduze ngemuva kwe-fret. Ungathinti intambo 1 ukuze ikhale.

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
From E minor to A minor
rows.translation: Ukusuka ku-E minor uye ku-A minor

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Usuka ku-E minor uye ku-A minor, iminwe 2 no-3 igxuma ndawonye iye ezintanjeni 4 no-3. Bese umunwe 1 uhlala entanjeni 2. Isandla sakho sinyakaza kancane kakhulu.

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Shaya izintambo kanye, bese usebenzisa ibha esele ukushintsha. Zama ukufika ku-chord entsha ngqo esigqini sokuqala. Ijubane lizozifikela kamuva.

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Iminwe yakho kufanele ihambe kanjani phakathi kwama-chord?

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Ukuhambisa iminwe ndawonye kuyashesha futhi kwenza umsindo ucace. Yigcine iphansi, ngaphezu nje kwezintambo.

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Yonke iminwe iyanyakaza ukusuka ku-A uye ku-E. Cabanga ukuma kwe-E ngaphambi kokuyiphakamisa, bese uhambisa yomithathu ndawonye. Qondisa umunwe 2 entanjeni 5.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard

Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Dust on the Dashboard: i-country ku-A. Ivesi ngalinye liphetha ngamabha amabili ka-E namabili ka-A, ushintsho osanda kulufunda. Cabanga ukuma, shintsha kusenesikhathi, ufike esigqini sokuqala. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Phezu kwe-E: B ovulekile, E ovulekile, D ku-fret 3 entanjeni 2, C ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 2, bese G ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 1 entanjeni 3.

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: E minor, E, A minor no-A. Beka ukuma ngakunye kucace, bese ushintsha ngokulinganayo.

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Yimuphi umunwe oguqula i-E minor ibe ngu-E?

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Umunwe 1 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 1, ufaka inothi elilodwa elenza i-E major.

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Ukushaya phansi, ama-quaver ashintshana phansi-phezulu, ukugcizelela, nesandla esingayeki.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyikota lithatha isigqi esisodwa. Shaya phansi kuzo zonke izigqi, ubale uphimisele: kunye, kubili, kuthathu, kune.

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Nyakazisa isihlakala nengalo engezansi kukhululekile, njengokuxukuza amanzi esandleni. Ingalo eqinile ikhipha umsindo onolaka.

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Kudingeka ukushaya okungamanothi ayikota okungaki ukugcwalisa ibha yezigqi ezine?

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Hlukanisa isigqi ngasinye kabili. Shaya phansi enombolweni, phezulu ku-and: one and two and. Lokho kungukushaya kasishiyagalombili kubha ngayinye.

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Phansi enombolweni, phezulu ku-and. Isandla sakho sehla senyuke kanye esigqini ngasinye.

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Ukushaya phezulu kuvame ukuba buthaka. Thinta kuphela izintambo ezintathu noma ezine ezizacile uma ukhuphuka. Lokhu kwenza isigqi sinyakaze kamnandi.

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Ukugcizelela kusho ukudlala inothi lizwakale kakhulu kancane. Shaya izintambo esigqini sokuqala ngamandla kunakwezinye. Lokhu kubonisa bonke ukuthi ibha iqala kuphi.

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Isigqi sokuqala siqala ibha. Ukushaya kokuqala okunamandla kancane kukugcina wena nalowo olalele nilandela isigqi.

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Yisho inombolo yebha esigqini sokuqala: kunye, kubili, kuthathu, kune; kubili, kubili, kuthathu, kune. Uzohlala wazi ukuthi ukuphi.

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Isandla sakho esishaya izintambo sehla senyuke ngaso sonke isikhathi, njenge-pendulum. Ukuze weqe ukushaya, qhubeka unyakaza ungazithinti izintambo.

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
Keeps moving and misses the strings
A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Isandla esingayeki sigcina isikhathi silingana. Ukushaya okweqiwe kungukunyakaza okungathinti izintambo.

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Le ndlela isetshenziswa ezingomeni ezingenakubalwa. Esigqini sesithathu isandla sehla singazithinti izintambo, bese sizishaya lapho sikhuphuka.

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Kule ndlela, yisiphi isigqi esingashaywa enombolweni?

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Kwesithathu isandla sehla singazithinti izintambo, bese sizishaya siya phezulu ku-and.

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Low Tide Radio: i-reggae ezolile ngo-E minor no-A. Isiginci sidlala kuma-and kuphela. Gcina isandla sehla senyuka, weqe izintambo enombolweni ngayinye, uzishaye kuwo wonke ama-and. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Isiginci sidlala kuphi ku-Low Tide Radio?

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: Ibhesi nezigubhu zidlala ezinombolweni. Isiginci siphendula phakathi kwazo, kuma-and.

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: amanothi ayikota, ama-quaver nokushaya kwe-folk kuma-chord owaziyo. Gcina isandla sinyakaza, ugcizelele isigqi sokuqala.

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Ama-quaver aphansi-phezulu: ukushaya phezulu kwenzeka kuphi?

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D no-D minor, ukulandelana okubili kwakudala kwama-chord, nokushintsha ngomzuzu owodwa.

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: U-C ukhuphuka njengezitebhisi: umunwe 3 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3; umunwe 2 entanjeni 4, ku-fret 2; umunwe 1 entanjeni 2, ku-fret 1.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lika-C lisentanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Qala ukushaya izintambo lapho.

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: A minor uye ku-C: umunwe owodwa

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: Iminwe 1 no-2 ihlala lapho ikhona. Kuhamba umunwe 3 kuphela, usuka entanjeni 3 uye entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3.

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: U-G usabalele: umunwe 2 entanjeni 6, ku-fret 3; umunwe 1 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 2; umunwe 3 entanjeni 1, ku-fret 3. Zonke izintambo eziyisithupha ziyakhala.

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: Uma ushintsha, qala ngokubeka umunwe wentambo enomsindo ophansi kunazo zonke. Yiyo yokuqala oyishayayo, ikunike ithuba lokubeka eminye.

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: U-D usezintanjeni ezintathu ezizacile: umunwe 1 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 2; umunwe 3 entanjeni 2, ku-fret 3; umunwe 2 entanjeni 1, ku-fret 2.

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lika-D liyintambo 4 evulekile. Izintambo 5 no-6 azikhali.

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: Ku-D minor, inothi lentambo 1 lehlela ku-fret 1. Hlela kabusha: umunwe 1 entanjeni 1, umunwe 2 entanjeni 3, umunwe 3 uhlale entanjeni 2.

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Ukhiye uyisisekelo sengoma. Kukhiye G, ama-chord G, C no-D enza umsebenzi omningi. Izingoma eziningi ze-folk ne-rock zisebenzisa lawa amathathu kuphela.

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Uhlala ufika sekwephuzile uma ushintsha. Yini esiza kakhulu?

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Ukushintsha kancane, uqale kusenesikhathi, kwakha umkhuba. Ijubane lizozifikela.

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Ukulandelana kwama-chord kuyaphindwa. U-A minor, C, G, D uqala ngomsindo omnyama, ukhanye njengoba ukhuphuka.

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Ngaphandle kohlelo, khetha ama-chord amabili uwashintshanise umzuzu owodwa, uwashaye kanye ngamunye. Bala ushintsho olucacile, uzame ukuludlula kusasa. Qala ngo-D no-D minor.

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
rows.translation: Uma ushintsha ngomzuzu owodwa, ubala ini?

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Kite Weather: i-pop ejabulisayo yokucula emlilweni, iphindaphinda u-G, D, E minor no-C. Shintsha kusenesikhathi, ubeke kuqala umunwe wentambo enomsindo ophansi kunazo zonke. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord ku-Kite Weather eyeqa izintambo 5 no-6?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lika-D liyintambo 4 evulekile, ngakho izintambo 5 no-6 azikhali.

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Ivesi lengeza u-A entanjeni 3, ku-fret 2: inothi lomunwe 1 ku-D. G ovulekile, A, bese B ovulekile.

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: C, G, D no-D minor bajoyina u-E minor, E, A minor no-A. Shintsha kusenesikhathi, ushaye ngokulinganayo, uvumele i-chord ngayinye ikhale.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G no-A entanjeni 3, D, E no-F entanjeni 4, i-scale ye-C major nemiculo emibili yendabuko.

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: Intambo 3 evulekile ingu-G. Beka umunwe 2 ku-fret 2 uthole u-A. Kusebenza umthetho ofanayo: umunwe ufaniswa ne-fret.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G no-A entanjeni 3, bese kuba ngu-B, C no-D entanjeni 2.

rows.source: G up to D and back
Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Intambo 4 evulekile ingu-D. I-fret 2 ingu-E, kanti i-fret 3 ingu-F. Gcina isithupha siphansi ngemuva kwentamo ukuze iminwe ifinyelele.

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: I-fret 2, bese i-fret 3: E, bese F.

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Intambo 4 evulekile nentambo 2 ku-fret 3 babelana ngaliphi igama?

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Kokubili kungu-D, kuhlukaniswe yi-octave: igama lenothi liyafana, omunye umsindo uphakeme kunomunye.

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E no-F entanjeni 4, bese kuba ngu-G no-A entanjeni 3.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Beka umunwe 3 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Ngu-C lowo, inothi i-scale ye-C major eqala ngalo.

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Intambo 5, i-fret 3, umunwe wesithathu. Ngu-C lowo.

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: I-scale ikhuphuka inothi ngenothi, isuka ohlamvini iye kolufanayo oluphakeme nge-octave. I-C major isebenzisa izinhlamvu nje: C D E F G A B C.

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Intambo 5 ku-fret 3, bese izintambo 4, 3 no-2. Dlala kancane.

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Kunamagama ezinhlamvu ahlukene amangaki ku-C major?

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, bese kuba ngu-C futhi, ephakeme nge-octave.

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Le ngoma yendabuko yenkolo yaba ngeyakudala ku-jazz. Isebenzisa u-C, D, E, F no-G ezintanjeni 5, 4 no-3.

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: Ukuqala: C, E, F, bese kuba ngu-G ovulekile.

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Amanothi okuqala ambalwa angenisa isigqi esinamandla abizwa nge-pickup. Lapha isigqi sokuqala sithule, kanti u-C, E no-F bangenisa u-G omude.

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: Ikhorasi: E E D C, bese C E G G G F.

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: I-Amazing Grace inezigqi ezintathu: bala kunye, kubili, kuthathu, ugcizelele esokuqala. Amanothi ayo asezintanjeni 4, 3 no-2.

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Ibha yezigqi ezintathu izwakala njengokuntengantenga okuthambile: ngamandla, buthaka, buthaka.

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: Ukuqala: D, G, B G, B, A. Izintambo 4, 3 no-2 ezivulekile, kanye no-A.

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Bese wehla: G, E, D, D.

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: Ingxenye ephakeme: B ovulekile ukhuphukele ku-D ku-fret 3, bese wehla ngo-B, G no-A.

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Halogen: i-desert rock ku-D minor. I-riff yayo isebenzisa amanothi osanda kuwafunda: D ovulekile, F ku-fret 3, G ovulekile, no-C entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Intambo 4 evulekile, F ku-fret 3, intambo 3 evulekile, bese C ku-fret 3 entanjeni 5.

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: wonke amanothi kusuka ku-C entanjeni 5 kuye ku-G entanjeni 1, nayo yomibili imiculo. Gcina isithupha siphansi, iminwe igobile.

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C major kusuka entanjeni 5, kukhuphukele ku-G entanjeni 1.

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: U-F omncane, D7, nezingoma ezimbili zendabuko ezinama-chord nomculo wamanothi.

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Lo F omncane usebenzisa izintambo ezine. Umunwe 1 ulala phezu kwezintambo 1 no-2 ku-fret 1, umunwe 2 uya entanjeni 3, ku-fret 2, umunwe 3 entanjeni 4, ku-fret 3.

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Tshekisa umunwe 1 kancane ohlangothini olubheke esithupheni. Uhlangothi olunethambo lucindezela izintambo ezimbili kalula. Hlola ukuthi intambo 2 iyakhala.

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Lokhu kulandelana kukhuphuka kancane kancane kusuka ku-A minor kugcine ku-F wakho omusha. Shaya kabili ku-chord ngayinye, ushintshe kusenesikhathi.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Lo mculo waseNgilandi uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-400. Wonke ama-chord awo uyawazi: A minor, C, G, E minor, F no-E. Unezigqi ezintathu: shaya kanye kubha, bese ushaya kuzo zonke izigqi.

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: U-F omncane uqala entanjeni 4. Qala ukushaya lapho, weqe izintambo 5 no-6.

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: I-sharp iphakamisa inothi nge-fret eyodwa. I-Greensleeves isebenzisa u-G ophakanyisiwe entanjeni 3, ku-fret 1, no-F ophakanyisiwe entanjeni 4, ku-fret 4. Finyelela lowo ngomunwe omncane.

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: G ophakanyisiwe, A, B: intambo 3 kuma-fret 1 no-2, bese intambo 2 evulekile.

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: Ukuqala: A, C D, E F E, D B.

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: I-sharp isho i-fret eyodwa phezulu. U-G ophakanyisiwe uphakathi kuka-G no-A.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Ikhorasi iqala phezulu: G entanjeni 1, ku-fret 3, bese F ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 2.

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: I-chord yesikhombisa yengeza inothi elidonsela enothini eliyisisekelo. U-D7 uholela ku-G. Iminwe: 2 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 2; 1 entanjeni 2, ku-fret 1; 3 entanjeni 1, ku-fret 2.

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Le ballad yaseMelika yangawo-1880 idinga u-G no-D7 kuphela. Inezigqi ezintathu, njenge-Amazing Grace. Shaya kanye kubha, bese ushaya kuzo zonke izigqi.

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Umculo we-Clementine usezintanjeni 4, 3 no-2. Umugqa wokugcina usebenzisa u-F ophakanyisiwe futhi: intambo 4, i-fret 4, umunwe omncane.

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Ukuqala: G G G, wehle uye ku-D ovulekile, ukhuphukele ku-B ovulekile.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Inothi elengeziwe ku-D7 lidonsela ku-G. Uma u-G efika, umsindo uyakhululeka.

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Umugqa wokugcina: A, D ovulekile, F ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 4, A, bese ubuyela ku-G oyisisekelo.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Ghost Light: i-ballad enensayo, enomuzwa omnyama. Ivesi layo lilandelanisa u-A minor, F, C no-E, usebenzise u-F omncane engomeni. U-G ophakanyisiwe ku-E ubuyisela umculo esisekelweni. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Lalela i-chord yokugcina yevesi. I-major noma i-minor?

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Ukushaya kwe-ballad: shaya ngamandla esigqini sokuqala uyeke kukhale, uphinde kwesithathu, bese phansi-phezulu kwesine. Isikhala ngemva kokushaya siyingxenye yengoma.

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Umugqa wokugcina wevesi: B ovulekile, C ku-fret 1, B, G ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 1 entanjeni 3, B, bese E ovulekile.

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: u-F omncane, D7 nezingoma zombili zale yunithi. Shintsha ama-chord kusenesikhathi, uvumele imiculo icule.

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 no-B7, ama-chord e-sus, i-shuffle ne-blues yakho yokuqala enamabha angu-12.

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Dlala u-E, bese uphakamisa umunwe 3 entanjeni 4. U-D ovulekile okhalayo uyinothi lesikhombisa, elengeza umuzwa wokungazinzi we-blues.

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Dlala u-A, bese uphakamisa umunwe 2 entanjeni 3. Kukhala u-G ovulekile, bese u-A eba ngu-A7.

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
rows.translation: Uguqula kanjani u-E abe ngu-E7 lapha?

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: U-G7 ugcina u-G ophansi kodwa ufaka u-F phezulu: umunwe 3 entanjeni 6, ku-fret 3; umunwe 2 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 2; umunwe 1 entanjeni 1, ku-fret 1.

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Yakha u-B7 kusukela entanjeni 5: umunwe 2 ku-fret 2, umunwe 1 entanjeni 4, ku-fret 1, umunwe 3 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 2, umunwe omncane entanjeni 1, ku-fret 2. Intambo 2 ikhala ivulekile.

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord u-B7 aholela kuyo kalula?

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: U-B7 udonsela ku-E. Ukungazinzi kwawo kuphelela ku-E minor noma ku-E.

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: I-shuffle ihlukanisa isigqi ngokungalingani: ukushaya phansi okude, nokuphezulu okufushane. Yisigqi esiyisisekelo se-blues. Cabanga u-hum-pty, dum-pty.

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Izingoma eziningi ze-blues zilandela uhlelo olulodwa lwamabha angu-12. Ku-E: amabha amane ka-E7, amabili ka-A7, amabili ka-E7, bese kuba yinye ka-B7, A7, E7 no-B7.

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Mangaki amabha ka-E7 aqala i-blues yamabha angu-12?

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Amabha amane okugcina ashintsha ngokushesha: B7, A7, E7, bese B7 okubuyisela ekuqaleni. Shintsha kusenesikhathi, uqhubeke ne-shuffle.

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: I-chord ye-sus ishintsha inothi eliyenza ibe yi-major noma yi-minor ngeleseduze. Izwakala ivulekile futhi ingakazinzi, kuze kube yilapho ibuyela esisekelweni.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Phakamisa umunwe 2 entanjeni 1 uthole u-Dsus2. Ku-Asus4, dlala u-A bese wengeza umunwe omncane entanjeni 2, ku-fret 3.

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Rust Belt Shuffle: i-blues yamabha angu-12 ku-E, uhlelo osanda kulushaya, nomculo onesigqi se-swing phezu kwalo. Gcina umuzwa wokude-kufushane ezandleni zombili. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: G ovulekile, bese G ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 1 entanjeni 3, bese B ovulekile: ukushelela kwe-blues kubha yesibili.

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Ibha yesibili ishelela isuka ku-G iye ku-G ophakanyisiwe. Yimuphi oku-E7?

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: U-E7 ungu-E, G ophakanyisiwe, B no-D. U-G uyinothi le-blues: uphikisana nomsindo we-chord, bese ushelelela kuwo.

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Ibha yesishiyagalolunye, phezu kwe-B7: F ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 2 entanjeni 1, E ovulekile, D ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 4 entanjeni 2 ngomunwe omncane, bese B.

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ama-chord esikhombisa, ama-chord e-sus ne-shuffle yamabha angu-12. Gcina isigqi sokude-kufushane silingana kukho konke ukushintsha.

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord esebenzisa yonke iminwe emine?

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Ama-power chord avulekile nanyakazayo, ukuthulisa ngesandla, ne-riff yakho.

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: I-power chord idlala kuphela inothi eliyisisekelo nelesihlanu, eliyizinhlamvu ezinhlanu phezulu. Ayiyona i-major noma i-minor; igcina amandla ngisho idlalwa kakhulu. U-E5 uyingxenye ephansi ye-E minor.

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Hambisa yona leyo minwe emibili uye ezintanjeni 4 no-3. Uma kwengezwa intambo 5 evulekile, kuba ngu-A5. Shaya izintambo 5, 4 no-3 kuphela.

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?
Rest the edge of your hand
Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Beka uhlangothi lwangaphandle lwesandla esincinzayo ezintanjeni, lapho zihlangana khona ne-bridge. Shaya, amanothi abe mafushane futhi aqine.

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.translation: Usibeka kuphi isandla uma uthulisa ngaso?

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Ku-bridge izintambo zisakhala, kodwa zibe mfushane. Uma usiyisa phambili isandla, ziyathula.

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: I-rock ivame ukwakha ngama-quaver athulisiwe, bese ifika ku-chord ekhala ngokukhululekile. Phakamisa isandla ekushayeni okunamandla, uyeke ikhale.

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Umunwe 1 entanjeni 6, ku-fret 3, bese iminwe 3 no-4 kuma-fret amabili phezulu ezintanjeni 5 no-4. Ngu-G5 lowo. Shelelisa ukuma, igama lilandele i-fret.

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lisentanjeni 6, ku-fret 5. Iyiphi i-power chord leyo?

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Bala ukhuphuke entanjeni 6: E ovulekile, F ku-1, G ku-3, A ku-5.

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Ukuma okufanayo kusebenza kusukela entanjeni 5. Umunwe 1 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3, unikeza u-C5. Thinta intambo 6 ngechopho lomunwe 1 ukuze ingakhali.

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: I-riff iyibinzana elifushane, elihehayo neliphindaphindwayo. Le ibuyela ku-E ophansi ovulekile. Beka uhlangothi lwesandla ku-bridge ukuze umsindo unganwebeki.

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: E ovulekile, intambo 6 ku-fret 3, bese A ovulekile.

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Ibha yesibili ikhuphuka entanjeni 5: i-fret 2, bese i-fret 5 ngomunwe omncane, ubuyele ku-fret 2. Gcina umunwe 1 useduze kwe-fret 2.

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Intambo 5: i-fret 2, i-fret 5 ngomunwe omncane, i-fret 2 futhi.

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Izingoma zivame ukuphendula i-riff ngama-power chord. Dlala i-riff, bese ushaya ama-chord kwesokuqala, ku-and wesibili, nakwesine.

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Shelelisa u-G5 ukhuphuke ngama-fret amabili. Uthola ini?

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: Ama-fret amabili ngaphezu kuka-G athola u-A. Igama le-chord lihamba nenothi layo eliyisisekelo.

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Basement Weather: i-garage rock ku-A. Iqala nge-riff ezintanjeni eziphansi, bese ama-power chord ephendula ngamandla kwesokuqala, ku-and wesibili, nakwesine. Gcina isandla ku-bridge. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: A ovulekile, C ku-fret 3 entanjeni 5, D ovulekile, bese G ku-fret 3 entanjeni 6 no-E ophansi ovulekile.

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Uyazi u-C5, umunwe 1 entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Shelelisa ukuma konke ukhuphuke ngama-fret amabili kube ngu-D5. U-G5 naye uku-fret 3, entanjeni eyodwa ephansi kuneka-C5.

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ama-power chord avulekile nanyakazayo, ukuthulisa ngesandla ne-riff yakho. Landela ukuchofoza, ugcine ukuthulisa kunembile.

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lisentanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Iyiphi i-power chord leyo?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: Intambo 5 ibalwa kusuka ku-A: B ku-2, C ku-3.

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?
The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: I-barre ka-F no-B minor, i-scale ye-A minor pentatonic ne-solo yakho yokuqala.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Ukufunda ama-barre chord agcwele kuthatha amasonto, ngakho wakhele kancane. Uyazi u-F omncane. Kulandela u-F wezintambo ezinhlanu, bese i-barre egcwele.

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Hambisa umunwe 3 uye entanjeni 5, ku-fret 3, ubeke umunwe omncane entanjeni 4, ku-fret 3. Kukhala izintambo ezinhlanu, u-F azwakale egcwele.

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Ama-barre chord anzima ekuqaleni. Yini esiza kakhulu?

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Amandla nomuzwa kukhula kancane. Ukuzijwayeza okufushane nsuku zonke kungcono kunesikhathi esisodwa eside esibuhlungu.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Lalisa umunwe 1 phezu kwazo zonke izintambo eziyisithupha ku-fret 1. Iminwe 2, 3 no-4 yakha ukuma kwe-E phambi kwawo. U-F ungu-E okhuphuke nge-fret eyodwa.

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Vumela isisindo sengalo sidonsele i-barre ngaphakathi, sengathi udonsela intamo kuwe ngobumnene. Isithupha siyayizinzisa kuphela. Tshekisa umunwe 1 uwubeke ngohlangothi.

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: I-barre ka-F iwukuma kuvulekile kwani okukhuphuke nge-fret eyodwa?

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Umunwe 1 ucindezela izintambo 1 kuya ku-5 ku-fret 2 njenge-barre. Iminwe 2, 3 no-4 yakha ukuma kwe-A minor ngama-fret amabili phezulu. Yeqa intambo 6.

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Awukakulungeli ukwenza i-barre? Dlala izintambo ezine eziphezulu kuphela: i-fret 4 ezintanjeni 4 no-3, i-fret 3 entanjeni 2, i-fret 2 entanjeni 1.

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord engu-E okhuphuke nge-fret eyodwa nge-barre?

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: I-scale ye-minor pentatonic inamanothi amahlanu. Ku-A minor angu-A, C, D, E no-G. Yilo msindo wama-solo amaningi e-blues ne-rock.

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Umunwe 1 udlala ku-fret 5 entanjeni ngayinye. Iminwe 3 no-4 idlala kuma-fret 7 no-8. Amanothi amabili entanjeni, umunwe owodwa ku-fret ngayinye.

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: I-fret 5, i-fret 8 entanjeni 6, bese i-fret 5, i-fret 7 entanjeni 5.

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: I-solo ingumculo owakhiwe ngamabinzana amafushane. Dlala amanothi ambalwa, ushiye isikhala, bese uphendula. Ukuphetha ngo-A, inothi eliyisisekelo, kuzwakala njengongqi.

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Yiliphi inothi elizwakala njengongqi ku-A minor?

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: U-A uyinothi eliyisisekelo, ikhaya le-A minor. Ukuphetha ibinzana ngaye kuzwakala kuphelile.

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre

Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Glass Satellites: i-power ballad ngo-A minor, F, C no-G. I-barre ka-F egcwele iyi-chord yesibili, kanti i-box 1 ihambisana nalo lonke uchungechunge, ngakho ithola i-solo. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Ku-chord F, yimaphi amanothi e-box 1 ayingxenye yayo?

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: U-F ungu-F, A no-C. I-box 1 ino-A no-C, ngakho bazwakala bezinzile phezu kuka-F.

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ama-barre chord, B minor, i-box ye-pentatonic ne-solo yakho. Phefumula, gcina isigqi, udlale ngomuzwa.

rows.source: Which finger covers fret 5 in box 1?
Thumb on the bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and a fingerpicked ballad.
rows.translation: Isithupha kubhesi, p-i-m-a, ukudlala kuka-Travis ne-ballad edlalwa ngeminwe.

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Ukudlala ngeminwe kusho ukuncinza ngeminwe esikhundleni se-pick. Isithupha sidlala izintambo zebhesi, 6, 5 no-4, sishaye esigqini njengesigubhu sebhesi.

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Isithupha kuphela: phushela phansi ezintanjeni 6, 5 no-4, ngayinye ngokulandelana.

rows.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Isithupha sidlala izintambo zebhesi. Eminye iminwe idlala ezizacile.

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Bamba u-A minor. Isithupha sidlala inothi eliyisisekelo entanjeni 5, bese siya entanjeni 4, inothi lesihlanu le-chord. Eliyisisekelo, elesihlanu, eliyisisekelo, elesihlanu: yibhesi eshintshanayo.

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Ukudlala ngeminwe kusebenzisa amagama eSpanishi: p yisithupha, i okhombayo, m ophakathi, a owendandatho. Beka u-i entanjeni 3, m entanjeni 2, a entanjeni 1, ulungele ukuncinza.

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: okhombayo entanjeni 3, ophakathi ku-2, owendandatho ku-1.

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p yisithupha, i okhombayo, m ophakathi, a owendandatho. Umunwe omncane uvame ukuphumula.

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Umunwe ngamunye uncinza uya phezulu, ubheke kancane entendeni, bese uyakhululeka. Gcina isandla singanyakazi ngaphezu kwezintambo, kuvunyelwe iminwe inyakaze.

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Indlela ka-Travis, eqanjwe ngo-Merle Travis, igcina isithupha sishintshana esigqini ngasinye, kanti eminye iminwe incinza phakathi, kuma-and.

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Sishintshanisa amanothi ebhesi kuzo zonke izigqi

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Isithupha sigcina isigqi silingana: inothi lebhesi esigqini ngasinye, sishintshana phakathi kwezintambo ezimbili.

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Gcina isithupha siqhubeka. Phakathi kwamanothi aso, u-m uncinza intambo 2, u-i intambo 3: isithupha, m, isithupha, i. Dlala kancane kuze kuzenzekele.

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Phakathi kwamanothi esithupha, yimuphi umunwe oncinza intambo 2?

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: Kule ndlela u-m udlala intambo 2, u-i adlale intambo 3. Umunwe a uyaphumula okwamanje.

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Uma i-chord ishintsha, isithupha sifika enothini elisha eliyisisekelo ngqo esigqini sokuqala. Eminye iminwe iqhubeka nokuncinza izintambo 2 no-3 njengakuqala.

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?
rows.translation: I-chord iyashintsha. Isithupha sakho siya kuphi?

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Ibhesi itshela indlebe ukuthi iyiphi i-chord oyidlalayo. Ukufika enothini eliyisisekelo esigqini sokuqala kwenza ushintsho lucace.

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Bamba i-chord ngayinye ibha yonke ukuze inothi ngalinye likhale lingene kwelilandelayo. Phakamisa umunwe kuphela uma ukuma okulandelayo kuwudinga.

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: I-arpeggio idlala i-chord inothi ngenothi. Le ilandelanisa u-p, i, m, a, bese yehla ngo-m, i. Amanothi ayisithupha agcwalisa ibha yezigqi ezintathu, amabili esigqini.

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Ngemva kokuba u-a encinze intambo 1, kulandela muphi umunwe?

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Ukulandelana kuyajika phezulu: p, i, m, a, bese m no-i uma kubuya.

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Ibha eyodwa ngakunye: A minor, F, C, G, bese A minor, F, E, A minor. Isithupha sithola inothi ngalinye elisha eliyisisekelo: izintambo 5, 4, 5 no-6.

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Porchlight: i-ballad enensayo ku-D. Yidlale ngeminwe: isithupha enothini eliyisisekelo le-chord ngayinye, bese i, m no-a bekhuphuka ezintanjeni 3, 2 no-1. Vumela inothi ngalinye likhale lingene kwelilandelayo. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lika-D liyintambo 4 evulekile. Izintambo 5 no-6 azikhali kule chord.

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ibhesi eshintshanayo, p-i-m-a, indlela ka-Travis ne-ballad. Gcina isithupha silingana, uvumele inothi ngalinye likhale.

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Phakathi kwamanothi esithupha, yimuphi umunwe oncinza intambo 3?

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: Amabha angu-12 ku-A, ukushintsha okusheshayo, ibhesi ye-boogie, ukubuyela ekuqaleni nama-lick akho okuqala e-blues.

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Ama-chord e-blues akhiwa enothini lokuqala, lesine nelesihlanu lokhiye. Ku-E angu-E7, A7 no-B7. Uma uya kukhiye A, aba ngu-A7, D7 no-E7.

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Kukhiye A, iyiphi i-chord eyenza umsebenzi owenziwa ngu-B7 ku-E?

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: U-B7 usekelwe ohlamvini lwesihlanu uma ubala usuka ku-E. Olwesihlanu usuka ku-A ngu-E, ngakho u-E7 uthatha indawo yawo.

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Amabha amane ka-A7, amabili ka-D7, amabili ka-A7, bese kuba yinye ka-E7, D7, A7 no-E7. U-E7 wokugcina ukubuyisela ekuqaleni.

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Ekushintsheni okusheshayo, ibha 2 iya ku-chord yesine ibuye ngqo. Ku-A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Lokhu kwenza umculo unyakaze zisuka nje.

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Ekushintsheni okusheshayo ku-A, iyiphi i-chord ekubha 2?

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: I-chord yesine ku-A ngu-D7. Ukushintsha okusheshayo kuya kuyo kubha 2, bese kubuyela ku-A7.

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Ukushintsha okusheshayo kusebenza kunoma yimuphi ukhiye. Ku-E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Qaphela u-B7 ngasekupheleni, i-chord yakho yeminwe emine.

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Umugqa we-boogie ukhuphuka nge-chord ubuye, inothi ngalinye kabili, kude-kufushane njenge-shuffle. Phezu kwe-A7 ukhuphuka ngo-A, C ophakanyisiwe, E, F ophakanyisiwe, G, bese wehla ubuya.

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: A ovulekile, i-fret 4 entanjeni 5, ama-fret 2 no-4 entanjeni 4, bese G ovulekile.

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Amanothi amabili epheyini ngalinye azwakala kanjani?

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Yi-shuffle futhi: inothi elide esigqini, elifushane ngaphambi nje kwesilandelayo.

rows.source: Move it to D and E
The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Ukuhamba okufanayo kuqala ku-D entanjeni 4 naku-E entanjeni 6. Phezu kwe-D7: D, F ophakanyisiwe, A, B, C. Phezu kwe-E7: E, G ophakanyisiwe, B, C ophakanyisiwe, D.

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
A lick that turns you around
Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Amabha 11 no-12 avame ukuthola i-lick emfushane ebuyisela ekuqaleni. Le yehla kusuka ku-A iye ku-E, nge-fret eyodwa ngesikhathi.

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Intambo 4: i-fret 4, bese 3, bese 2. Yeka u-E akhale.

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Kumabha amabili okugcina. Kubuyisela indlebe kubha 1 ukuze kuqale futhi.

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Shaya amabha ayishumi okuqala ngokushintsha okusheshayo, bese udlala i-lick kumabha 11 no-12. Ibhendi ye-blues iphetha kanjalo umzuliswano ngamunye.

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: I-box yakho ye-A minor pentatonic ihambisana ne-blues ku-A. U-C wayo uphikisana no-C ophakanyisiwe oku-A7, futhi lokho kungqubuzana kungumsindo we-blues.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Ku-blues eku-A, yiliphi inothi elizwakala liyisisekelo?

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: U-A uyinothi eliyisisekelo lokhiye. Ama-lick aphetha ngo-A azwakala ezinzile; u-G no-C bakushiya ulindele ukuqhubeka.

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Amabinzana e-blues ayakhuluma wodwa. Dlala i-lick 1 njengombuzo, bese uphendula nge-lick 2 efika ku-A ophansi.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Neon Laundromat: i-funk ehlala ku-chord eyodwa, A7. Ibinzana layo elihehayo lishelela ku-C liye ku-C ophakanyisiwe, njengokungqubuzana kwama-lick akho e-blues, kanti ikhorasi yehlela ku-E7. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A ku-fret 2 entanjeni 3, bese C no-C ophakanyisiwe kuma-fret 1 no-2 entanjeni 2, bese E ovulekile.

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Phezu kwe-A7, yiliphi inothi eliphikisana ne-chord?

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: U-A7 ungu-A, C ophakanyisiwe, E no-G. U-C we-box yakho ye-pentatonic uphikisana no-C ophakanyisiwe wayo, kanti ibinzana elihehayo lishelela lisuka komunye liye komunye.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: I-Neon Laundromat ayinayo i-shuffle. Dlala i-boogie yakho ngama-quaver alinganayo, ibe umugqa webhesi ngaphansi kwe-A7: A, C ophakanyisiwe, E, F ophakanyisiwe, G, bese wehla.

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: amabha angu-12 ku-A naku-E, ukushintsha okusheshayo, umugqa we-boogie, ukubuyela ekuqaleni nama-lick akho. Gcina i-shuffle inyakaza.

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Ekushintsheni okusheshayo ku-E, iyiphi i-chord ekubha 2?

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Ama-hammer-on, ama-pull-off, ukushelela, ama-bend ne-vibrato, ne-box yesibili ye-pentatonic.

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: I-hammer-on ikhalisa inothi lesibili ngesandla esicindezelayo sodwa. Ncinza inothi, bese wehlisa omunye umunwe ngokushesha nangokuqinile ngemuva nje kwe-fret ephakeme. Intambo iqhubeka ikhale.

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Ncinza intambo 3 evulekile, bese wehlisa umunwe 2 ku-fret 2. Ungalincinzi inothi lesibili.

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Intambo 3: bamba i-fret 5 ngomunwe 1, uncinze, bese wehlisa umunwe 3 ku-fret 7.

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Ijubane nokunemba kubaluleke kunamandla. Fika ngechopho lomunwe ngemuva nje kwe-fret, intambo iqhubeke ikhale.

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: I-pull-off yehlela enothini eliphansi. Iminwe yomibili icindezele, ncinza inothi eliphezulu, bese ususa umunwe ophezulu ngokuwudonsela eceleni ukuze uncinze intambo lapho usuka.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: I-fret 2 entanjeni 3, bese ususa umunwe 2 ngokuwudonsela eceleni ukuze kukhale u-G ovulekile.

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Iminwe 1 no-3 kuma-fret 5 no-7. Ncinza, bese udonsela umunwe 3 eceleni uwususe.

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Ukuphakamisa uqonde phezulu kuthulisa inothi. Ukudonsela umunwe eceleni kancane kuncinza intambo kukhalise inothi eliphansi.

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Ukuze ushelele, ncinza inothi, uqhubeke ucindezela lapho ushelela ngawo lowo munwe uye ku-fret entsha. Ukucindezela kugcina umsindo; kuncinzwa inothi lokuqala kuphela.

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Umunwe 3 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 7. Ncinza, bese ushelela ukhuphukele ku-fret 9 ungawuphakamisanga.

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Lapho ushelela, yini egcina inothi likhala?

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Uma uyeka ukucindezela, inothi liyathula. Gcina ukucindezela okufanayo uze ufike ku-fret entsha.

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Manje buyela: ncinza ku-fret 9, ushelele wehlele ku-fret 7.

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: I-bend iphusha intambo ivundle ku-fret ukuze iphakame umsindo. I-bend yethoni egcwele, elingana nama-fret amabili, ukusuka ku-fret 7 kufanele izwakale ncamashi njenge-fret 9.

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Intambo 3, i-fret 9: yilo nothi ofuna ukufinyelela kulo nge-bend. Liyeke likhale, ulikhumbule.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Beka umunwe 3 ku-fret 7, iminwe 1 no-2 ibe ngemuva kwawo entanjeni efanayo. Phusha yomithathu ibheke ophahleni, ujikise isihlakala njengokujikisa isibambo somnyango.

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: I-bend yakho ku-fret 7 izwakala iphansi kune-fret 9. Wenzani manje?

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: I-bend engafinyeleli enothini elihlosiwe ayizwakali kahle. Phusha kuze kufane nenothi elihlosiwe olizwile.

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Inothi elihlosiwe, bese i-bend engafinyelelanga kulo. Inothi liyafana noma lihlukile?

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: I-vibrato iwukuphusha intambo kancane uyidedele, uphindaphinda ngokushesha enothini elibanjwe lide. Yenza ukunyakaza kube kuncane futhi kulingane ukuze inothi lihlale lishunile.

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Amanothi afanayo amahlanu aphindeka phezulu entanyeni. I-box 2 iqala lapho i-box 1 iphela khona: umunwe 1 ku-fret 7 ezintanjeni 5, 4 no-3, umunwe 2 ku-fret 8 ezintanjeni 6, 2 no-1.

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Intambo 6: ama-fret 8 no-10. Intambo 5: ama-fret 7 no-10.

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Amanothi afanayo amahlanu aku-box 1, A C D E G, endaweni entsha entanyeni.

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Ukuze usuke ku-box 1 uye ku-box 2, shelelisa umunwe 3 usuke ku-fret 7 uye ku-fret 9 entanjeni 3. Ufika ku-box 2 isandla sesisendaweni efanele.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Saltwater Sunday: i-reggae ezolile ku-A minor, u-Am7 no-D7 beshintshana ngamabha. Womabili ama-box e-pentatonic ayahambisana nawo. Sebenzisa ama-hammer-on, ama-pull-off nokushelela, ufike enothini le-chord ekuqaleni kwebha. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Phezu kwe-D7, yiliphi kulawa manothi e-box eliyingxenye ye-chord?

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: U-D7 ungu-D, F ophakanyisiwe, A no-C. U-C, inothi lawo lesikhombisa, uzwakala uzinzile; u-E no-G bayadlula nje.

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ama-hammer-on, ama-pull-off, ukushelela, amanothi okuhloswe ngama-bend, i-vibrato nama-box womabili. Dlala ibinzana ngalinye licace, bese ulenza licule.

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: I-bend yethoni egcwele kusuka ku-fret 7 kufanele ifane ne…

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Inothi elihlosiwe, bese i-bend. Inothi liyafana noma lihlukile?

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Ukuma kwe-E nokwe-A phezulu entanyeni, i-major ne-minor, ukuma okuseduze, nokulandelana ku-A.

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: I-barre yakho ka-F iwukuma kwe-E okune-barre ku-fret 1. Shelelisa konke phezulu, igama lilandele inothi eliyisisekelo entanjeni 6: ku-fret 3 ngu-G, ku-fret 5 ngu-A.

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: I-barre emise okwe-E ku-fret 5. Iyiphi i-chord?

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Intambo 6 ibalwa kusuka ku-E: F ku-1, G ku-3, A ku-5. I-fret ye-barre inikeza i-chord igama.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Phakamisa umunwe 2, uvumele i-barre icindezele intambo 3. Lokhu ukuma kwe-E minor, kuhamba ngendlela efanayo: F ophakanyisiwe minor ku-fret 2, A minor ku-fret 5.

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: U-B minor bewuwukuma kwe-A minor okune-barre. Nokuma kwe-A major kuyahamba: yenza i-barre ezintanjeni 1 kuya ku-5, bese ulalisa umunwe 3 ezintanjeni 4, 3 no-2, ngama-fret amabili phezulu.

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: I-barre emise okwe-A ku-fret 3. Iyiphi i-chord?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Intambo 5 ibalwa kusuka ku-A: B ku-2, C ku-3, D ku-5.

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Ku-minor, sebenzisa iminwe ye-B minor: 2, 3 no-4 yakha ukuma kwe-A minor phambi kwe-barre. Ku-fret 3 kuba ngu-C minor.

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Ama-chord amaningi angasebenzisa ukuma kwe-E, isisekelo entanjeni 6, noma ukuma kwe-A, isisekelo entanjeni 5. Khetha okuseduze nalapho isandla sesikhona.

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Udlala u-G ku-fret 3. Ukuphi u-C oseduze kakhulu?

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyisisekelo lika-C lisentanjeni 5, ku-fret 3. Hlala ku-fret 3 ushintshele ekumeni kwe-A.

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Usuka ku-G uye ku-C ku-fret 3, umunwe 1 uhlala ku-barre. Kushintsha iminwe ephambi kwawo kuphela. Lolu ushintsho lwe-barre olushelela kunawo wonke.

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Intambo 5: A ovulekile, B ku-2, C ku-3, D ku-5.

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.translation: F ophakanyisiwe minor, D, A, E

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: U-F ophakanyisiwe minor, D, A no-E bonke bakukhiye A. Qala ngo-F ophakanyisiwe minor njenge-barre, abanye abathathu bavuleke.

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: U-F ophakanyisiwe minor nge-barre emise okwe-E uku…

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Intambo 6: F ku-fret 1, F ophakanyisiwe ku-fret 2.

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Dlala phezulu entanyeni: F ophakanyisiwe minor ku-fret 2, D ngokuma kwe-A ku-fret 5, A ngokuma kwe-E ku-fret 5, E ngokuma kwe-A ku-fret 7.

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Yehlisa ukucindezela kwe-barre isikhashana lapho uhamba, ucindezele uma ufika. Ukubamba ngamandla njalo kukhathaza isandla, kwenze ushintsho lunense.

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Isandla esicindezela izintambo kufanele sicindezele nini?

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
